title: Studio: an edit the Data, Automations or Interfaces pillar is still holding (not yet saveable) is discarded silently when the builder leaves the pillar, switches item or reloads — no confirm, no beforeunload
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named.
Batch-of: studio-qa-2026-10-27 — 39 cards from one Studio QA run (coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`; tested at `3fcafcd3`; `origin/main` was `43731031` at filing, so the implementer re-checks the landing site on current main). The run record is the `qa-run` issue filed with this batch.

## Symptom

Studio keeps an incomplete edit "held" until it can be saved, and says so ("Your changes are kept here and saved once it is filled in"). Leaving the pillar, switching to another object/flow, or reloading drops that held edit with no confirm and no browser beforeunload prompt. The Access pillar and Interfaces navigation edits do guard departure, so the behaviour is inconsistent across pillars.

## Reproduction

1. Data: writable package › Data › an object › Form › Add field "Priority", type Picklist, no option yet (the strip says the change is kept). Click the Automations pillar link → navigation proceeds with no confirm; back in Data › Form, Priority is gone. Reload with the held edit → no beforeunload prompt.
2. Automations: Start → add a step whose config is incomplete (held) → switch pillar / switch flow in the rail / reload → the step is gone, no confirm.
3. Interfaces: dashboard › add a widget that is not yet complete (held) → leave the pillar → the widget is gone, no confirm.

## Expected

Every pillar treats a held edit as unsaved work: the in-app leave confirm, the rail switch confirm and beforeunload all fire, as they already do for Access and for Interfaces navigation edits.

## Suspected landing site (the implementer verifies)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: `onDirtyChange={setPillarDirty}` is wired only for AccessPillar and InterfacesPillar (navigation dirtiness only); DataPillar and AutomationsPillar report held state only through `onHeldEditChange`, which gates Publish but not departure (`confirmLeavePillar` / beforeunload / `useRegisterUnsavedEdits` read `pillarDirty` only).

## Filing facts

- reach: Studio UI, measured once per pillar (Data by the coordinator, Automations and Interfaces by their QA cards).
- Business reason: A builder who is halfway through a field, step or widget loses it on one stray click and is never told; the product promises "kept here".
- Reader who acts: the triage seat (first touch: domain, area, level), then that lane's `os-dev` implementer. QA suggestion only: `domain:ui`, `area:studio`, p2.
- Dedupe: semantic search `Studio held edit lost on leaving pillar no unsaved changes guard` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 0 hits.
- QA id: F1
